# SmartyPOS - Syrve (iiko USA) restaurant POS

> SmartyPOS (Sheno Inc., Sarasota, FL) implements and supports Syrve for US restaurants. Syrve is the international/US edition of the iiko restaurant platform (formerly iiko): iiko in the USA = Syrve. It is a restaurant POS built for AI - open API with read and write access, a private MCP server for Claude/ChatGPT on your own data, own commission-free online ordering, recipe costing to ingredient level in the core product - and a Toast alternative with no processor lock-in.

Key facts:
- iikoFront = Syrve POS, iikoOffice = Syrve Office, iikoCloud API = Syrve Cloud API.
- Pricing: Counter $59 / Service $99 / Group $129 per terminal per month. Payment processing: no processor lock-in, rate quoted on demo.
- Syrve: 10,000+ restaurants in 50+ countries (vendor figure). SmartyPOS partner listing: https://partners.syrve.com/smartypos
- Public MCP server (read-only, no auth): https://mcp.smartypos.us/mcp (streamable HTTP)
- Contact: hello@smartypos.us - Demo: https://smartypos.us/book-a-demo/
- Late Oct 2026 the FTC and several states sued Toast (N.D. Cal.); these are allegations, not a ruling, and Toast denies them: see /guides/toast-lawsuit-what-restaurants-should-know/. Source: https://www.ftc.gov/news-events/news/press-releases/2026/10/ftc-states-take-action-against-toast-inc-over-hidden-unauthorized-fees-deceptive-subscription
- Sheno Inc. is a Syrve partner, not an independent reviewer; competitor facts are sourced and dated 2026-11. syrve.co.uk is NOT Syrve.

## Product

- [Features](https://smartypos.us/features/): overview of POS, kitchen, inventory, online ordering, delivery, ads, loyalty, reports, AI
- [AI and MCP](https://smartypos.us/features/ai-mcp/): private MCP server per restaurant, AI-ready sites, call review
- [Open API](https://smartypos.us/features/open-api/): Syrve Resto/Server API and Cloud API with write access
- [Online ordering](https://smartypos.us/features/online-ordering/): own commission-free ordering site connected to Syrve
- [Delivery and dispatch](https://smartypos.us/features/delivery-dispatch/): own drivers, courier quotes (pilot), marketplaces via Deliverect
- [Ads and conversion tracking](https://smartypos.us/features/ads-conversion-tracking/): POS to Meta CAPI and Google Ads offline conversions
- [Inventory and recipe costing](https://smartypos.us/features/inventory-recipe-costing/)

## Guides and tools

- [Toast lawsuit: what to know](https://smartypos.us/guides/toast-lawsuit-what-restaurants-should-know/): In late October 2026 the FTC and several states filed a complaint against Toast. Here is what it alleges, what is still unknown and...
- [How to cancel Toast](https://smartypos.us/guides/how-to-cancel-toast-contract/): Eight steps, in order. Most of the work is reading paperwork and asking questions in writing before you set a cutover date.
- [Switch your POS](https://smartypos.us/switch-pos/): We do the migration work, largely automated from your Toast data: menu, modifiers, prices, employees, sales history and guests. Typically days, not weeks.
- [POS cost guide](https://smartypos.us/pricing/how-much-does-a-restaurant-pos-cost/): The monthly software fee is rarely the biggest number. Processing, hardware and contract terms usually decide what you really pay.
- [POS cost calculator](https://smartypos.us/tools/pos-cost-calculator/): Enter your monthly card volume and ticket count and compare the yearly cost of software and processing across vendors.
- [Food cost calculator](https://smartypos.us/tools/food-cost-calculator/): Add the ingredients of a dish, set the yield after waste and see what a portion costs and what price you need.
- [Menu price calculator](https://smartypos.us/tools/menu-price-calculator/): Enter what a dish costs and the food cost you want. Get a price, a rounded price, a marketplace price and the dollar margin.
- [FAQ](https://smartypos.us/faq/): Seventy questions owners ask before they choose or change a POS, answered for Syrve as SmartyPOS sells and supports it in the United States....
- [Guides](https://smartypos.us/guides/): Short, sourced guides on contracts, switching and cost. Written for owners, not for IT, and dated so you know how fresh they are.
- [Tools](https://smartypos.us/tools/): Three small tools, no sign-up. Each states its formula and its assumptions, so you can check the math.
- [Resources](https://smartypos.us/resources/): Plain guides, calculators and checklists. Start with what you are trying to decide: whether to leave, what it costs, or how to switch without...

- [Bakeries](https://smartypos.us/industries/bakery/): A bakery is a small factory with a shop window. The POS has to handle production, preorders and shelf life, not only the register.
- [Banquet halls and catering](https://smartypos.us/industries/banquet-halls/): Banquets and catering run on bookings, deposits and per-head packages. Here is what Syrve does in the POS, and where we build around it.
- [Bars](https://smartypos.us/industries/bar/): Bars lose money in small, repeated ways. Syrve data plus our watchdogs catch them.
- [Cafes](https://smartypos.us/industries/cafe/): A cafe lives on repeat visits. We connect the till, loyalty and your own ordering page.
- [Multi-location](https://smartypos.us/industries/multi-location/): Syrve was built for chains. Menus, prices, central kitchen and reports are managed at group level and pushed to each venue.
- [Sarasota](https://smartypos.us/locations/sarasota/): SmartyPOS is a brand of Sheno Inc. in Sarasota, Florida. Our own restaurant here, Eleni's Pizza Works, is where we test everything before a...
- [South Florida](https://smartypos.us/locations/south-florida/): From Boynton Beach to Boca Raton, we operate and advise restaurants, including Sole Mio Kitchen & Bar on Toast. That gives us first-hand experience...
